evals.prompt: I am starting a MAUI homework app with no pages yet. Help my students build a learning book while we create a profile screen with save validation.
evals.expected_output: Select the new-project mode, propose a small student-approved roadmap, and start with one source-grounded chapter contract rather than dumping the project.

evals.prompt: Our MAUI app already has a Shell, a video list, SQLite services, and tests. We need a guided book that gets students to a filter-and-sort goal. Decide the right steps with us first.
evals.expected_output: Inspect and map the existing project, identify the current state and end goal, then ask the user to choose a milestone sequence before authoring chapters.

evals.prompt: Create a step-by-step guide for this supplied dashboard design. We cannot capture an emulator, but the final learning book needs HTML snapshots and a PDF with no blank or clipped pages.
evals.expected_output: Create an HTML visual model with data-guide selectors, use the generic capture tool, label it as a model, and require the generated HTML/PDF validation report before publication.
